descriptions.notStarted: I should go and meet with Kidd. His royal highness is asking for me so...
descriptions.inProgress: You're telling me he's the Ruling King of the Seagulls? Why would the King of the Seagulls be looking for me? Well, let me go see him and find out.
descriptions.completed: Jonathan... The King of the Seagulls. Well he certainly has a presence about him.
